generator: built-in image_gen, separate transparent-background call per stage
style: smooth cartoon, dark warm-brown outlines, warm orange and green palette
asset_policy: See assets/README.md Passport v0 materials; illustration assets are excluded from the code MIT license.
integration_notes: Use a common ground anchor and uniform scale based on the mature plant, rather than fitting each stage independently to the target box.
RGBA source files preserve generated alpha. Very faint alpha values below 8 extend beyond the visible sprite, as in the bloom reference.
Visible bounds below use alpha >= 8; coordinates are left, top, right-exclusive, bottom-exclusive.
The one-pixel canvas-height difference of the bud must be accounted for in mechanical normalization.
Source generation changed no existing files; runtime integration now creates shared 55x65 canvases at calibrated visible heights 14/28/50 pixels.

stages.prompt_summary: One tan-brown seed slightly peeking out of the same low brown soil mound; no foliage; reference cartoon style; tall transparent canvas and shared soil scale.
One short curved green stem and two small rounded leaves in the same soil mound; no bud or flower; about 40 percent mature height; reference cartoon style and transparent canvas.

One closed narrow orange tulip bud with petal seams on a curved green stem and two leaves; same soil mound; about 75 percent mature height; no open petals; reference cartoon style and transparent canvas.

constraints_common_to_all: One plant-stage sprite only; no pot, face, text, extra plants, scenery, decoration, floor, cast shadow, or baked checkerboard. Preserve transparency.
